title: Limits on the storage of quantum information in a volume of space
abstract: Tradeoff bounds for approximate quantum error correcting codes on lattices. Introduces local approximate correctability and code distance with several equivalent formulations, generalizing exact error-correction criteria; bounds relate n, k, distance, the accuracy parameter and locality.
key_claims: Source of the decoupling <=> recoverability duality that PAPER-2026-142 imports as its Theorem 1: erasure of A is locally correctable from AB iff ACR decouples into A and CR
relevance_note: Catalogued from the abstract only, NOT read. It is the origin of the observable HYP-033 uses (mutual information between a reference and a boundary region as a recoverability measure), so that observable is cited to it and to PAPER-2026-142, never claimed.
